goal: Prevent untrusted user inputs from forging fake entries in debug.log
Protects node operators and monitoring tools from being misled by injected error messages
reviewability: Ready for review, with nothing known that would invalidate looking at the code now
agreement: Strong support for centrally escaping newlines to prevent log forging
Verified by manual testing of RPC log injection and wallet creation (polespinasa)
Support for the minimal escaping fix and expanded warning tests (ryanofsky, w0xlt)
Supported global escaping to cover external daemon inputs as well (davidgumberg)
Open question on whether the logging interface has format string risks (Crypt-iQ)

categories.name: utils
why: P2 because it eliminates a log-injection vulnerability where user input could forge log entries
Prevents callers from injecting fake block connection failures or errors that confuse monitoring tools
